messages:
anna (prod-eng): Starting eu1 canary v2.4.0 now — 5% traffic. Run quick smoke set: kvprobe, synth-short, and health ping.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollout/v2.4.0 -> eu1-canary (5%)
josh (eng-releases): copying minimal checklist: `./ci/smoke/smoke-short.sh --route embed --samples 50`
leila (sre): kicked off synth-short, watching p95 and token errors. alert thresholds set: p95>150ms, 5xx>0.3%
deploy-bot: Smoke run 1: kvprobe ok, synth-short p95=128ms, 5xx=0, samples=50
anna (prod-eng): typo — i'm anna, not anna. (small typo) carry on :sweat_smile:
sam (oncall): FYI trace shows a tokenization mismatch spike on two samples for /v1/gen at t+45s. low impact but notable. tagging @leila
leila (sre): saw that. digging into tokenizer host logs, looks like a new subtoken table loaded slower on host-03. not an inference kernel issue.
josh (eng-releases): can we replay the synth against a fresh host set excluding host-03?
leila (sre): running targeted replay now excluding host-03.
deploy-bot: Smoke run 2 (excl host-03): synth p95=131ms, 5xx=0, token-mismatch=0/60
anna (prod-eng): good. two options: 1) continue ramp to 25% and monitor for 10m, or 2) pin v2.4.0 to gen-route only and keep embed on v2.3.x. preferences?
josh (eng-releases): lean towards mixed-variant pin to reduce blast radius. we can pin gen-route to v2.4.0 and leave embed pinned to v2.3.5 for now.
leila (sre): agree, mixed pin reduces risk. add auto-fallback: if token-mismatch > 0.2% for 3m, rollback gen-route to v2.3.5 automatically.
sam (oncall): set manual watch for 15m after pin before further ramps. I'll be on standby.
anna (prod-eng): deploying mixed pin policy now. updatng release notes with gen/embed split and tokenization note.
deploy-bot: Rollout updated: eu1-canary -> gen-route=v2.4.0 (5%), embed-route=v2.3.5 (stable)
josh (eng-releases): added release note snippet: "v2.4.0: gen improvements + tokenizer integration — gen route canary only; embed pinned to v2.3.5 pending token table validation."
leila (sre): logged synth artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/rollouts/4401239999/v2.4.0/smoke_short.log
sam (oncall): setting alerts: token-mismatch >=1 sample triggers slack err channel; p95 > 180ms triggers paging.
deploy-bot: Canary progress t+10m: gen p95=133ms, token-mismatch=0.02%, 5xx=0. No alarms.
anna (prod-eng): thanks team. we'll keep the mixed pin for 24h and schedule tokenizer table rollout in next maintenance window. closing thread, follow-ups in #eng-runtime if we see anomalies. :thumbsup:
